Sure! Below is a quick guide to help you get started with the Data Artifex environment and the available tools. Feel free to ask follow‑up questions if you need more detail on any step.

---

## 1️⃣  Open or Create a Project

```python
# Open an existing project (or create a new one if it doesn't exist)
open_project(
    path="/path/to/your/project",
    create_new=True,          # set to False if you only want to open
    access_mode="edit"        # or "read-only"
)
```

* **`path`** – Absolute or relative path to the project folder.  
* **`create_new`** – If `True`, a new project will be created when the folder is empty.  
* **`access_mode`** – `"edit"` lets you modify files; `"read-only"` protects them.

---

## 2️⃣  Manage Servers

### 2.1  Add a PostgreSQL Server

```python
add_postgres_server(
    nickname="prod-db",
    host="db.example.com",
    port=5432,
    database="main",
    username="db_user",
    password="super_secret"
)
```

### 2.2  Add an MTNA RDS Server

```python
add_mtnards_server(
    nickname="mtna-prod",
    host="rds.example.com",
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY"
)
```

### 2.3  Connect to a Server

```python
connect_to_server(
    nickname="prod-db",
    timeout=60,
    use_ssl=True,
    port=5432
)
```

### 2.4  Rename a Server

```python
rename_server(
    _from="old-nickname",
    to="new-nickname"
)
```

### 2.5  List Servers

```python
list_servers(type="postgres")   # or "mtna", "rds", "all"
```

---

## 3️⃣  Work with Files

```python
# List all Python files in the project
list_files(type="py", include_hidden=False)

# List all Markdown files, including hidden ones
list_files(type="md", include_hidden=True)
```

---

## 4️⃣  Get Help

```python
dartfx_help(
    topic="postgresql connection",
    search_deep=True,
    language="English",
    format="text"
)
```

* **`topic`** – Keyword or phrase you need help with.  
* **`search_deep`** – `True` for a thorough search (may take longer).  
* **`language`** – Output language.  
* **`format`** – `"text"`, `"audio"`, or `"video"`.

---

## 5️⃣  Close the Project

```python
close_project(
    save_state=True,
    confirmation="CONFIRM",
    timeout=30
)
```

* **`save_state`** – Save any unsaved changes.  
* **`confirmation`** – Must be `"CONFIRM"` to proceed.  
* **`timeout`** – Seconds to wait before forcing closure.

---

### Quick Tips

| Task | Command | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| Create a new project | `open_project(..., create_new=True)` | Use a clean folder for a fresh start. |
| Add a server | `add_postgres_server(...)` or `add_mtnards_server(...)` | Keep credentials secure. |
| Verify connectivity | `connect_to_server(...)` | Test after adding a server. |
| Search help | `dartfx_help(...)` | Use `search_deep=True` for exhaustive results. |
| Clean exit | `close_project(...)` | Always confirm before closing. |
